annotations.title: Read why a market is moving: facts, rooms, not known

description: The evidence behind one Hyperliquid market's move, as the Torii Station's 'Why moving?' panel shows it: the price change (1h and 24h), up to 5 knowledge-graph facts about the company or token (each with its source URL and date), the Hive rooms tagged with the market (posts in the last 7 days, last post) with the 2 newest posts quoted as written, and what is NOT known (no news source is connected; Hive stores no for/against stance, so room_view is always null). Also the asset's full name (name_full), its home market (home_market) and local_media: generated SEARCH links (local-language news and YouTube, an English news and YouTube search, and a translated version of the local news page) built from fixed templates; each has checked=false because nobody looked at what it returns. A part that did not answer in time is null and named in `unreadable`. One cached read (180 s per market). Read-only, no key, free. Not news, not a prediction and not advice. Requires: market ('xyz:SKHX', 'main:BTC' or a bare coin 'BTC').
name: cockpit_evidence
title: Read why a market is moving: facts, rooms, not known
